UPSC Topper Ishan Bhatnagar AIR 05 | One-on-One Session | UPSC CSE 2025 | ForumIAS
#UPSC #UPSCTopper #IshanBhatnagar #UPSCCSE2025 #ForumIAS

Overview:
In this insightful one-on-one conversation, Ishan Bhatnagar, who secured AIR 05 in the UPSC Civil Services Examination 2025, shares his preparation journey, strategy, and mindset behind cracking one of India’s toughest exams.

From building strong fundamentals to mastering answer writing and staying consistent through the preparation cycle, Ishan explains what truly works for aspirants preparing for the Civil Services Examination conducted by the Union Public Service Commission.

This one-on-one session dives into practical preparation tips, mistakes to avoid, revision strategies, and how to maintain focus during the long UPSC journey. A must-watch discussion for every serious UPSC aspirant looking for guidance from a top ranker.
